headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text:
Fallen and destroyed stop sign and street name signs were reported a while back .  Street sign and sign for Menchaca road was replaced. Thank you!  
But the street name sign for Independence Drive was not replaced.  This is a private road and has a blue sign.  Will the city of austin replace it please.  Or is it the responsibility of Indeoendence Park Condominium community? Please let me know asap

Need trash cans to protect our environment. Trash cans have been removed from the parking lot by Austin high school right where people park and also the path going underneath the exit from MoPac as people walk to fifth Street.
The amount of trash with ACL will be off the charts

Please add more trash cans and pick ups

I do not see an option to talk about trash, so I use the next best I could find

A dangerous metal pipe was protruding from the roadway near 6712 Hart Lane. On September 25, 2026, at approximately 8:56 AM, my vehicle struck the protruding pipe, damaging my tire. After the impact, I observed the pipe lying beside the curb and an open hole in the roadway. Please repair and secure the area urgently.

This map of Lakewood identifies the PRIVATE Streets managed by the HOA. We are requesting signs that indicate Private Street! Dogwood Hollow has been replaced. We need the same for the other private streets.

Loose dogs, this house has 6 dogs that bark day and night and not monitored. Now there are holes in 2 different fences and I have seen up to 3 of them in my yard (owner not aware at all). I reported this previously and need action to be taken, one of these dogs is going to get hit by a car or bite my dog. it is extremely unsafe for all. Video is of one of the dogs in my yard, photo of 5 of the at

Debris still in road over a week later from last reports. Homeowners referenced in previous ticket by 311 did not clear the street of their mess as promised over a week ago. Please remove it, we can’t park in the street and it’s dangerous. All down the side of this address
WATR Rooftop blasting music until 2am. Please do something about it, we literally can’t sleep. PLEASE NOTE- you can’t hear it from the street(at all). The do not have OMV PERMIT

Pedestrian signal struck and hit at N-IH35 service road southbound and E Rundberg LN. It is moved to the side of the road and an orange barrel is over the connection wires. Removed by Austin Fire Department Station 23. Submitted by FF Jonathan Benavides TXFR3394

A skunk died in my backyard a week or two ago and has since been at least mostly stripped to the skeleton by bugs/etc. Should I just dispose of it in my weekly trash pickup? (Properly bagged, of course.) Or would the City *prefer* to pick it up? I understand I would have to be present.

Barrett’s Too playing illegal amplified sound yet again. We have reported this many times and it has not stopped. It is great affecting my business next door because we host small quiet meetings and the noise causes major disruption. Please stop them.

Dog is repeatedly loose and has threatened to attack both humans and dogs. The owner doesn’t care when the dog is loose and only called the dog off potential human attacks when one neighbor pulled a knife and one pulled a gun (two separate incidents). The dog(s) need to be tested and rehomed. They are not safe.

An old sofa was dumped in front of the lot at the intersection of Lansing Drive and Richmond. The city previously put a “no dumping sign” in the lot to deter dumping, but the sign recently broke off and needs to be replaced (see photo). Thank you.

This trailer has been parked here for days and is extremely dangerous at night. No reflectors and several people I have talked to have almost hit it, including me, as it’s so hard to see. It’s near the corner of Oak View and  Vallecito.

Two cars that seem to be abandoned. Both cars belong to 4603 Pack Saddle, but they moved them (one in front of 4605 ) before they moved out a month ago.  The white BMW is parked the wrong way.  The black BMW is at least 18” from curb.

6205 Burnet Road is operating "Iron Forge” Event featuring amplified sound positioned inside a warehouse enclosed by only 3 walls, which legally defines it as an Outdoor Amplified Sound source under Austin City Code Title 9, Chapter 9-2.The business does not hold an active Outdoor Music Venue (OMV) permit. source of this outdoor amplified music is located < 100 ft from residentially-zoned property

Major pothole on a bike route where someone could get seriously hurt. This is the 2nd time reporting. Escalation to City Council Member’s Office and City Manager is next. I expect it fixed. This is on Arroyo Seco not Koenig. So COA not TxDOT.

Hi,

I am writing to report a pothole that requires repair.

The pothole is located in the far-left lane on Wells Branch Parkway, heading in the east-to-west direction, directly in front of the H-E-B entrance. Here is the approximate location on google maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/6qeb9VPE8AuGYrZH8 [maps.app.goo.gl]
Bungalow/Victory Lap way above the 85 dBA level (again)!  Austin Police, please actually give them a citation and not another warning.   They don’t follow the law consistently.

A truck is illegally parked in a designated tour bus loading zone.  It is blocking tour buses from being able to park and load/unload customers.  This causes a backup of traffic. This vehicle needs to be towed.

I would like to submit a noise complaint regarding Naya. Since opening, the business has consistently hosted DJs and events every weekend with seemingly little regard for the surrounding neighbors.

Loud amplified music can be heard regularly during weekend brunch hours, creating an ongoing disturbance for nearby residents and businesses. This has become a recurring issue rather than an isolated e

This morning, in daylight conditions, we had a raccoon in our front yard. It was approaching the house and our children (who were inside), but visible through the windows / doors. Despite trying to ward it off to allow our children to go to school, the raccoon prowled undeterred for several minutes.

Bolt sticking up in walk/bike path on west end of the bridge over Shoal creek in the Grove.  This is a tripping hazard and bike tire puncture hazard. The top of bolt should be cut off or the meta plate reattached so the round end of the bolts is up

Overgrown tree branches and grass are entirely blocking the public right-of-way, forcing pedestrians, children, and parents with strollers to walk directly into the street. A previous work order was closed, but the hazard remains completely unaddressed as the vegetation is severely overgrown and creating an immediate safety risk.

JW Delivery Trucks Blocking Sidewalk and Bike Lanes on 3rd Street. This happens extremely regularly 
-- original (de-US) --
JW delivery trucks blocking sidewalk and bike lanes on 3rd street. This happens extremely regularly

Car is fully blocking my driveway.  Was issued a citation under 26-00316116 and I tried to open another call under 26-00316187 but that could take days.  Please tow this vehicle so that I can use my driveway.

-- auto translated (en) --
Every day, cars park on my driveway exit, block my exit. The Sidewalk is too short to forget a car, so I can easily only park there or put a trash can there, so much to buy into my life.
-- original (zh-hans-CN) --
Every day, cars park on my driveway exit, blocking my exit. The sidewalk is too short to accommodate a car, so I can usually only park temporarily or put a tr

Apparently, the city of Austin's Sanitation Team had a rough night last night, and are having trouble getting the trash 🗑 into the back of their truck thos morning.  It's a bit of a mess over here, and it doesn't smell very good either.  Woodbrook Circle and Greenslop, 78759

Potentially contaminated medical/biohazardous waste dumped in the alley, including blood vials and gloves. I don’t know whether there are sharps present. It needs to be handled as potentially hazardous waste.

I don’t know where to send this to but there is a water line under the road that is leaking.  There is a pothole in the road that is always full of water and it’s getting worse every week.  This section of water line has broken and leaked before, road was torn up and repair was made previously.  So there is a pothole in the road and is full of water because the water line under street is leaking.

Left turn signal from Koenig to Burnet is extremely short, it took 11 minutes from stopping to making the turn. The light maybe cycled 5 times before I was able to pass through. Normally this light takes me 2-3 minutes to pass through at the same time of day.

The left turning arrow painted on the street is faded on Northbound Grover, south side of Koenig. Drivers think they’re in a lane that can go straight and crowd out the right lane after crossing Koenig. There’s a sign posted on the light but it’s hard to see because the power lines obstruct it. There’s also 3 sets of light but only 2 lanes. Removing one of the lights, repainting the turn lane arro

trash under Western Trails Blvd culvert between 2222 Western Trails Blvd and 2312 Western Trails Blvd., each day there is different street people and different belongings. There is a rug under there and many other things.
We are so tired of dealing with this daily.  Some of the street people get biligerent and they scare us and our tenants

This dog continues to jump over our fence from our neighbors house into the backyard. This happened two years ago and we reached out through 311 back then. I put up some bird spikes to prevent this from happening again. The dog stopped but it appears the neighbor has added something into the backyard that allows the dog to jump over the fence in a different area now.
stop sign 🛑 is ignored and people almost wrecking every day?! please add blinking light to stop sign!
Two lamp posts on Sendero Hills Drive in the Agave development, closer to the Loyola intersection than the MLK intersection, have not illuminated in the last two weeks. Please repair them.
Dead animal in a garbage bag discarded on side of trail at Walnut Creek park. I submitted a ticket 20 mins ago with what3words GPS location. Created a 2nd ticket with a map detailing where
WATR restaurant noise complaint. It’s now past 11pm and even louder. Loud horns and bass blaring into the Quincy. It’s so loud. Please have the djs and restaurant turn down the music.

I know its a tradition, but Im literally begging y’all to get them to stop playing margaritaville on loop for just this night. we’ve got classes tomorrow and i did not sign up to be hazed by jimmy buffet by on a thursday night.
Watr rooftop 12th floor at 1Hotel is playing heavy bass music rn per usual. Please can we do something about this, it’s disturbing all residents whois leaving facing their bar.

Cars park in the bike lane every evening, blocking it. there are a couple no parking signs but people just ignore them. dozens of parking citations have been issued for this bike lane in the last month alone
